alert_news.title: V.O.C. Port Becomes India's First Scope-2 Emission-Free Major Port
bullets: V.O.C. Port in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, became India's first major port to achieve Scope-2 Emission-Free status on 10 August 2026.
The port secured ISO 50001:2018 certification for its Energy Management System, with renewable energy meeting 93.89% of its total electricity consumption in 2025-26.
V.O.C. Port has 7.04 MW of solar capacity, 2 MW of wind capacity, and plans to add 2 MW of ground-mounted solar capacity, 17 MW of wind capacity with 5 MWh battery storage, and a Green Hydrogen Hub.

alert_news.title: Skyroot, HEX20 Sign Multi-Launch Agreement for 3 Vikram Missions
bullets: Skyroot has signed a multi-launch agreement with HEX20 for 3 Vikram missions, following the successful launch of Vikram-1, India's first privately developed orbital-class rocket.
This collaboration aims to enhance access to space and promote private sector participation in India's space program.
The agreement marks a significant milestone in India's space sector, with private players like Skyroot playing a key role in the country's space ambitions.

alert_news.title: Cavotec wins tender to install automated mooring system at Jawaharlal Nehru Port
bullets: Cavotec has won the bid to install Automated Mooring System (AMS) at Jawaharlal Nehru Port, a first in India, as a pilot project to enhance operational safety, efficiency, and reduce vessel turnaround time.

The auto mooring system 'MoorMaster' will be installed at Gateway Terminals India Pvt Ltd (GTI), a private container terminal, to expand its container handling capacity to 3 million TEUs over the next few years.
The automated mooring system will help GTI handle 2.4 million TEUs in the fiscal year ending March 2027, despite having a limited quay length of 712 metres.

alert_news.title: India's Gen Z and the AI Era: Turning Demographic Strength into an AI Dividend
bullets: India's Gen Z is the first generation to step into higher education and the workplace in the age of AI.
India's demographic dividend can be transformed into an economic and AI dividend if Gen Z is equipped to thrive in an AI-driven world.
Employers are valuing qualities that machines cannot easily replicate, such as critical thinking, creativity, ethical judgement, learning agility, and emotional intelligence.

alert_news.title: Zydus launches REVAHALE, India's first once-daily nebulised LAMA for COPD treatment
bullets: Zydus Lifesciences launched REVAHALE (Revefenacin), India's first once-daily nebulised Long-Acting Muscarinic Antagonist (LAMA) for Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) treatment.

REVAHALE is the first LAMA in India offering once-daily dosing with nebulised administration, addressing challenges associated with inhaler-dependent therapies, especially among elderly patients and those with severe respiratory impairment.
Clinical studies demonstrated significant and sustained improvements in lung function in patients with moderate to very severe COPD, while maintaining a favourable safety profile.

alert_news.title: Russian Cosmonauts Extend Independence Day Greetings to India from ISS
bullets: Russian cosmonauts aboard ISS conveyed special greetings to India on its 80th Independence Day, holding the Indian tricolour and highlighting the enduring partnership in space exploration.

The cosmonauts recalled the decades-long collaboration between Moscow and New Delhi, citing milestones like the Soviet launch of Aryabhata (India's first satellite) in 1975 and Rakesh Sharma's first Indian spaceflight in 1984.
The partnership has moved into a fresh phase with India's Gaganyaan human spaceflight programme, with Indian astronauts receiving training at the Yuri Gagarin Cosmonaut Training Centre in Russia.

alert_news.title: Russian Cosmonauts Greet India Ahead of 80th Independence Day from ISS
bullets: Russian cosmonauts aboard ISS extended greetings to India ahead of 80th Independence Day, holding the Indian Tricolour.
India-Russia space cooperation dates back to 1975, with the Soviet Union launching Aryabhata, India's first satellite.
India's Gaganyaan human spaceflight programme has entered a new phase of bilateral cooperation, with Indian astronauts undergoing training at the Yuri Gagarin Cosmonaut Training Centre in Russia.

alert_news.title: India's Remote Sensing and Cartographic Satellite Programmes: A Milestone in Earth Observation
bullets: India maintains one of the largest civilian remote sensing satellite constellations in the world, managed by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).

The Indian Remote Sensing (IRS) satellite system has evolved from experimental satellites in the late 1970s to operational constellations providing sub-metre spatial resolution imagery, synthetic aperture radar (SAR) all-weather monitoring, and hyperspectral data.

ISRO has launched several specialized remote sensing satellite series, including Resourcesat (Land & Agriculture) and Oceansat (Oceanography & Coastal Zones), targeting land resources, oceanography, atmosphere, and high-resolution mapping.
